description: Write a clock event (stamp) for an employee (POST /events) — e.g. start work, start a project, pause, end of day. Required: employee_id, task_id (2 Ladezeit, 3 Fahrzeit, 4 Projekt, 5 Pause, 6/7 Sonder, 8 Logout (Feierabend), 9 Dienstreise, 10 Arbeitszeit), occurred_at (ISO). Optional: project_id (for task 4), task_label. Changes recorded working time — needs approval.

task_label.description: Optional label for the clock event
